thread:
olivia: Hey team — after our Okta->SCIM sync this morning I can still open the project but all action buttons are disabled (Create API key, Add teammate). Console shows 403 on any write attempt. Happening on two projects in our org. Anyone seen this? @support
support-bot: Thanks for the report, Olivia. Ticket created: #SR-3129. Please add repro steps + a screenshot/log.
matt_s: can you paste the exact error you see when trying to create an API key? Also which auth method (SSO, API key, delegated token)?
olivia: steps:
1) SSO login via Okta
2) switch org -> select project "acme-frontend"
3) click "Create API key" -> modal opens then fails
Curl shows 403:
```
POST /api/v2/projects/1234/keys
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...
Response: 403 {"error": "permission_denied", "missing_scopes": ["projects:write"]}
```
I think our Identity team changed some mappings this morning.
dinesh_id: thanks — do you have the decoded JWT claims? especially `scp` / `roles` claim.
olivia: pasted minimal claims:
```
{"sub":"U-6789","email":"olivia@acme.com","roles":["billing_manager"],"scp":["billing:read","projects:read"]}
```
matt_s: aha — token has projects:read but not projects:write. If you're using delegated tokens via our idp proxy, the proxy might be scoping tokens to billing-only for web sessions. Can you confirm whether this is an Okta session token (SSO session) or an on-the-fly delegated token created by the CLI? :thinking:
olivia: it's the browser SSO session. We didn't touch CLI. Yesterday write actions worked.
dinesh_id: probable cause: SCIM group-to-role mapping in Okta lost the `project_admin` group claim during the sync. Okta will map groups -> roles; if the group is missing, you can still view but not modify.
kate_pm: Confirming — we rolled a SCIM resync at 09:10 and there were some warnings about group collisions.
matt_s: interim workaround: use a service API key from a project admin or ask org admin to re-add the `project_admin` group mapping in Okta. Long-term we'll add an automated guard in the sync that refuses to drop existing role mappings without review.
olivia: can you verify with engineering whether the sync dropped claims or just stopped emitting projects:write? I can open a support window with Okta logs.
dinesh_id: I'll pull the sync job logs. matt_s — can you escalate to identity team? I'll paste the job id shortly.
matt_s: on it — looping in @sanjay. Also, olivia, can you try incognito and re-auth (sometimes session cached tokens persist)?
olivia: tried incognito — same 403. Happy to share Okta trace. Thanks all! :pray:
